en: Type the yearly rent and the allowance for repairs. The tax rate comes from Start. You get the tax, the half-year payment and what to set aside each month.
mt: 输入年租金和维修津贴。税率来自Start。您会收到税款、半年付款以及每个月的预留款项。

en: Type the amount you advanced and the months to repay. The interest rate comes from Start. You get the instalment, the interest and the last payment date.
mt: 输入您预付的金额和还款月份。利率来自Start。您可以获得分期付款、利息和最后付款日期。

en: Add every unit on Units with its monthly rent and whether it is let.
mt: 在 Units 中添加每个单元的月租金以及是否出租。

en: Post every money movement on Ledger: rent in, expenses, our fees, payouts and reserve moves. Choose the kind, category, property and owner; the signed amount and the statement fill in.
mt: 在 Ledger 上发布每笔资金变动：租金、费用、我们的费用、支出和储备金变动。选择种类、类别、属性和所有者；签署的金额和声明填写。

en: 30, 90 and 365-day occupancy, ADR and RevPAR with owner stays taken out of the nights you could sell
mt: 30、90 和 365 天的入住率、ADR 和 RevPAR（业主住宿从您可以出售的夜晚中扣除）

en: One row per holiday home: rates, rules, owner, access details and live results such as occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, revenue and owner payout.
mt: 每个度假屋一行：费率、规则、业主、访问详细信息和实时结果，例如入住率、ADR、RevPAR、收入和业主支出。

en: Wi-Fi name and password
mt: Wi-Fi 名称和密码

en: Your price calendar: each season has a price multiplier and a minimum stay. What it earned fills in from Bookings; the pricing tool reads it.
mt: 您的价格日历：每个季节都有价格乘数和最短停留时间。其收入由 Bookings 填写；定价工具会读取它。

en: Type your base rate, the arrival date, the length of stay and how full the next 30 days are. The season comes from Seasons; discounts and the weekend increase come from Start.
mt: 输入您的基本房价、抵达日期、住宿时间以及接下来 30 天的入住情况。季节来自季节；折扣和周末加价都来自于Start。

en: Type the booking figures and the owner's share. The result is the same split Bookings uses, plus what the owner receives after costs.
mt: 输入预订数字和所有者的份额。结果是 Bookings 使用相同的分割，加上所有者在扣除成本后收到的金额。

en: Hello {guest}, the Wi-Fi at {unit} is: {wifi}. Enjoy your stay!
mt: 您好 {guest}，{unit} 的 Wi-Fi 是：{wifi}。祝您住宿愉快！

en: Hello {owner}, an update on {name}: occupancy over the last 90 days {occ90}, room revenue over the last 12 months {rev12}. Call us if you want to review the prices.
mt: 您好 {owner}，{name} 的更新：过去 90 天的入住率 {occ90}，过去 12 个月的客房收入 {rev12}。如果您想查看价格，请致电我们。

en: 5. Check that lights, air conditioning, TV and Wi-Fi work. Report any damage, missing items or low stock the same day with photos.
mt: 5. 检查灯光、空调、电视和 Wi-Fi 是否正常。当天请附上照片报告任何损坏、物品缺失或库存不足的情况。

en: Test lights, air conditioning, TV and Wi-Fi
mt: 测试灯光、空调、电视和 Wi-Fi

en: Send the check-in details and Wi-Fi
mt: 发送入住详情和 Wi-Fi

en: Fit the smart lock and test Wi-Fi
mt: 安装智能锁并测试 Wi-Fi

en: Add each holiday home on Listings: rate, cleaning fee, owner, owner share, minimum nights, Wi-Fi and check-in method.
mt: 在列表中添加每个度假屋：房价、清洁费、业主、业主份额、最低入住天数、Wi-Fi 和入住方式。

en: Type every reservation on Bookings: channel, guest, dates, nightly rate, cleaning fee, commission and tourism tax. Revenue, shares and clashes fill in.
mt: 在 Bookings 上输入每项预订：渠道、客人、日期、每晚价格、清洁费、佣金和旅游税。收入、股票和冲突充斥着。

en: Every trip to a property, owner, vendor or authority: who went, in which vehicle, why and how far. The cost of the trip comes from your cost per kilometre in Start.
mt: 每次前往财产、业主、供应商或当局的旅行：谁去了、乘坐哪辆车、为什么去以及走了多远。行程费用来自您在 Start 中每公里的费用。
